religion_note: CBS survey estimate, pooled over 2021-2025 (Religie naar regio, 2021/2025, from the survey Sociale samenhang en welzijn): the share of the non-institutional population aged 15 and over who consider themselves members of a religion, weighted by CBS. Sample: about 7,500 respondents a year, some 37,500 over the five years; CBS prints a region only when at least 300 observations stand behind it and does not print the number, so this province rests on at least that. 'Other or unspecified religion' is CBS's 'ander geloof': everyone outside the Roman Catholic Church, the Protestant churches and Islam who does not say they have no religion -- other Christian groups as well as Judaism, Hinduism, Buddhism and any other religion or philosophy of life; CBS does not divide it. 'No religion' is everyone who does not consider themselves a member of one (100 less 'Totaal gelovig'). The Netherlands has had no questionnaire census since 1971 and no register records religion.
language_basis: survey estimate: self-identification, residents aged 15 and over in private households
language_note: European Social Survey, ESS rounds 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 (2014-2024), pooled: the language most often spoken at home, first mentioned (lnghom1); a language named by fewer than 5 respondents here is in Other languages. A survey estimate, not a count: 296 respondents in NUTS region NL13 gave an answer (0 refused, did not know or did not answer and are left out), weighted within each round by the post-stratification weight (pspwght), rescaled to that round's respondents here, and pooled. Low precision: under 300 respondents. Universe: residents aged 15 and over in private households who could be interviewed in a survey language. Tabulated by the ESS Data Portal's open analysis service. The census does not ask home language here, or its figure is not published for this unit; a census or register count replaces this estimate wherever one has been found.
ethnicity_note: Population by migration background on 1 January 2022 (CBS StatLine 84910NED, from the population register): MIGRATION BACKGROUND, not ethnicity, which no Dutch register records. CBS's definition until 2022: a person's own country of birth, or for someone born in the Netherlands the mother's, or the father's where the mother was born in the Netherlands too; 'Dutch' is CBS's Nederlandse achtergrond, both parents born in the Netherlands, whatever the person's nationality. 'Dutch Caribbean' is the former Netherlands Antilles and Aruba as CBS reports them; backgrounds below 0.3% of the country are 'Other migration background'. CBS replaced the classification with 'herkomst' from 2022, and 1 January 2022 is also the date of the division the map draws.

religion_note: CBS survey estimate, pooled over 2021-2025 (Religie naar regio, 2021/2025, from the survey Sociale samenhang en welzijn): the share of the non-institutional population aged 15 and over who consider themselves members of a religion, weighted by CBS. Sample: about 7,500 respondents a year, some 37,500 over the five years; CBS prints a region only when at least 300 observations stand behind it and does not print the number, so this province rests on at least that. 'Other or unspecified religion' is CBS's 'ander geloof': everyone outside the Roman Catholic Church, the Protestant churches and Islam who does not say they have no religion -- other Christian groups as well as Judaism, Hinduism, Buddhism and any other religion or philosophy of life; CBS does not divide it. 'No religion' is everyone who does not consider themselves a member of one (100 less 'Totaal gelovig'). The Netherlands has had no questionnaire census since 1971 and no register records religion.
language_basis: survey estimate: self-identification, residents aged 15 and over in private households
language_note: European Social Survey, ESS rounds 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 (2014-2024), pooled: the language most often spoken at home, first mentioned (lnghom1); a language named by fewer than 5 respondents here is in Other languages. A survey estimate, not a count: 210 respondents in NUTS region NL34 gave an answer (1 refused, did not know or did not answer and is left out), weighted within each round by the post-stratification weight (pspwght), rescaled to that round's respondents here, and pooled. Low precision: under 300 respondents. Universe: residents aged 15 and over in private households who could be interviewed in a survey language. Tabulated by the ESS Data Portal's open analysis service. The census does not ask home language here, or its figure is not published for this unit; a census or register count replaces this estimate wherever one has been found.
ethnicity_note: Population by migration background on 1 January 2022 (CBS StatLine 84910NED, from the population register): MIGRATION BACKGROUND, not ethnicity, which no Dutch register records. CBS's definition until 2022: a person's own country of birth, or for someone born in the Netherlands the mother's, or the father's where the mother was born in the Netherlands too; 'Dutch' is CBS's Nederlandse achtergrond, both parents born in the Netherlands, whatever the person's nationality. 'Dutch Caribbean' is the former Netherlands Antilles and Aruba as CBS reports them; backgrounds below 0.3% of the country are 'Other migration background'. CBS replaced the classification with 'herkomst' from 2022, and 1 January 2022 is also the date of the division the map draws.
